text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Moroccan trade minister starts visit to Baghdad.
- Iraqi News Agency INA celebrates today (Saturday) its founding anniversary.
- An international symposium on the impacts of embargoes imposed on many countries starts in Geneva.
- Iraq holds talks with Italian firms on oil investment.
- Baghdad sponsors an international conference on the reservation of environment in the Arab world.
